StowMind 1.3 folds the shared macOS icon cache into the Agent cleanup flow and keeps the iPhone planner improvements from 1.2.

## Agent cleanup

- Scanning from the Agent page now also probes the shared icon cache. When the fresh measurement is complete but unauthorized, the administrator review chains automatically from the same scan entry — there is no separate button to remember.
- The dedicated "通过 Mole 清理" action on the cache card is removed. After review, the bottom "清理已选内容" action cleans the selected Agent items and the reviewed cache together, with an explicit confirmation for both.
- The shared card only shows status and keeps a "重新复核授权" fallback for expired or invalidated reviews; Doctor's read-only view is unchanged.

## iPhone Home Screen organization

- Packed pages can be reordered in place, and apps can move between pages automatically (up to 3 flips, landing verified before release). The never-delete constraint is unchanged.

## Permissions and upgrade notes

- No new permissions are required; Administrator review, Screen Recording, and Accessibility behave as before.
- The password prompt appears only when a scan comes from the Agent page's own entry — a post-execute refresh stays read-only.
- Users on the earlier 1.2.0 build should install this version manually; version-only update checks do not cover the same-version replacement.
